clustersCollapsed.rationale: Four sources describing the same emergencyTransfer surface from four angles (implementation drift / economic principal-loss / structural CENTRALIZATION-ADMIN / SAST signal). Single function, single line, shared remediation.

Three reward-bearing entrypoints (claim/stake/withdraw) all share the same root cause (debt rebase happens after external mint+transfer) and the same one-line remediation (add nonReentrant + reorder CEI). SLITHER-007/008/009 (reentrancy-events, Low) are subsumed by SLITHER-003/004/005 (reentrancy-no-eth, Medium) which are themselves the SAST shadow of CODE-004/005/006 / PATTERN-001/002/003. Single cluster with three line-instances.
Same setDesiredAPY surface; PATTERN-005 is the structural CENTRALIZATION-ADMIN match, ECON-001 is the economic phUSD-inflation framing. ECON-001 is the stronger narrative.
Same setDepletionDuration surface; PATTERN-006 is the structural match, ECON-002 is the one-tx flash-drain analysis.
Same root (no debt rebase in pauseWithdraw) and same remediation; CODE-009 is the spec-vs-event angle, ECON-011 is the orphan-redistribution angle.
ADERYN-006 is the SAST shadow of CODE-011 (state-change-without-event on line 206).

INV-01 fuzzer counterexample and SYMBOLIC-001/002 Halmos witnesses are not standalone findings — they are EVIDENCE PROMOTING CODE-002 from potential-high to verified-high. Folded in under evidence{} on the canonical.
INV-01 (same shrunk sequence as DEDUP-002 because the assertion is on view helpers) and SYMBOLIC-003/004 Halmos witnesses are evidence promoting CODE-007.

SYMBOLIC-005 is a positive proof that the two-step gate state-machine works as designed. It is cross-referenced into DEDUP-006 (the magnitude-cap finding) and DEDUP-010 (the MEV failure of the gate) as supporting evidence — not as a vulnerability.

handoffNotes: Sanitizer should treat DEDUP-001 as matches-known-issue (lib/phlimbo-ea/CLAUDE.md V1 rate-recompute) and suppress before classification.

Sanitizer should preserve DEDUP-008 (collectReward(1) griefing) even though it amplifies the same V1 bug — it is a fresh permissionless-amplification surface and has its own remediation (access control on collectReward).

DEDUP-002 and DEDUP-003 share the same arithmetic primitive; classifier may want to keep them separate (DEDUP-002 = High mutating-path DoS, DEDUP-003 = Medium view DoS) and the report-writer should bundle their remediation in a single fix.

DEDUP-005 is the strongest single cluster (12 raw inputs collapsed). Splitting it back into 3 separate submissions (claim / stake / withdraw) is acceptable for C4-style per-entry-point reports; the cluster preserves the shared root-cause and remediation framing.
DEDUP-014, DEDUP-015, DEDUP-022 are borderline findings that severity-classifier may demote to QA bundle.
DEDUP-021 (observability gap) sits between Medium and Low — its severity depends on how report-writer pairs it with DEDUP-004 (emergencyTransfer).
All severity hints carried forward are best-effort labels; final severity is severity-classifier's call.
